sourceV3.Acquisition_Platform: Mobile phone rear camera (top and side views; videos from side view)
sourceV3.Camera_Type: Mobile phone rear camera (top and side views; videos from side view)
sourceV3.Weather_Conditions: Rain season and summer season captures
sourceV3.Label_Taxonomy: Class labels for road structures: potholes; speed breakers; roadside barriers; paved and unpaved surfaces
sourceV3.AI_Task_Evidence: Reported on the source record/data card or associated publication (see Evidence_Locator)
sourceV3.Key_Limitations: Annotation format, per-class counts and annotation method are unreported; the label set mixes distress (potholes) with road furniture (speed breakers, barriers) and surface type, so it is not a pavement-condition taxonomy; no severity; no peer-reviewed data paper located
sourceV3.Reconciliation_Notes: Single source record; no reconciliation required.
sourceV3.V3_AI_Evidence_Note: The v2 description reports 8,484 images and 13 videos, paved/unpaved roads in Nashik and Mumbai, seasons and phone viewpoints. It does not separate independent image origins from video frames or define an annotation schema.
